resetPassword.invalid: This reset link is invalid or has expired.

twoFactorChallenge.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactorChallenge.intro: Enter the 6-digit code shown by your authenticator app.

twoFactorSetup.title: Enable two-factor authentication
twoFactorSetup.required: Two-factor authentication is mandatory for the owner and admin roles. Enable it to continue.
twoFactorSetup.optional: Protect your account with a second factor.
twoFactorSetup.scan: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app, or enter the key below.
twoFactorSetup.enterCode: Enter the 6-digit code shown by the app.
twoFactorSetup.backupIntro: Keep these codes somewhere safe. Each one allows a single sign-in if you lose access to your app. They will not be shown again.

verify.subject: Verify your email address
verify.body:
Hello {name},

To activate your ProofLayer account, open this link:
{url}

If you did not make this request, ignore this email.

resetPassword.subject: Reset your password
resetPassword.body:
Hello {name},

To choose a new password, open this link, valid for one hour:
{url}

If you did not make this request, ignore this email: your password stays unchanged.
